scope: Case-specific decisions; not a universal sequence
property_validation_policy: Reuse CHEPTA property models, parameter provenance and existing validation. Lab checks applicability to components, conditions and required calculation; it does not routinely remeasure or revalidate phase equilibrium. Investigate underlying data only for a concrete missing parameter, range violation or material disagreement. Process-level balance and performance checks still apply.

records.rationale_classification: author-stated process purpose; conditions changing selection are Lab engineering questions, not demonstrated alternatives
records.problem: Acid remains in the reactor vapor stream.
records.candidate_operation: Azeotropic distillation with acid-rich bottoms returned to the reaction section.
records.physical_or_process_reason: Separate and retain reactant while forwarding the ester-containing mixture.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Column composition profile, acid carryover and recycle balance.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Acid content already meets downstream requirements or another reactor/separation arrangement removes this need.

records.rationale_classification: author-stated process purpose; conditions changing selection are Lab engineering questions, not demonstrated alternatives
records.problem: The ester/ethanol/water mixture is not brought to final purity by the reported initial distillation.
records.physical_or_process_reason: Partition ethanol into the aqueous phase and enrich the organic phase in ester.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Phase split at mixed-feed conditions, component recovery and stage requirements.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Single-liquid conditions, excessive ester loss, or another feasible separation route.

records.rationale_classification: author-stated process purpose; conditions changing selection are Lab engineering questions, not demonstrated alternatives
records.problem: Extraction performance depends on temperature and available cooling.
records.candidate_operation: Condition the feed temperature where the integrated benefit justifies it.
records.physical_or_process_reason: The authors report improved organic-phase enrichment after cooling; this is conditional, not a universal cooling rule.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Heater/cooler duty plus extraction and downstream duties at feasible utility conditions.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Cooling cannot reach the proposed temperature or costs more than the downstream benefit.

records.problem: The enriched organic phase still contains impurities.
records.physical_or_process_reason: Use the changed composition to reach final product specifications.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Purity and recovery together with reflux, stages, feed location and duty.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Specifications are already met, thermal constraints intervene, or another feasible purification is preferable.

records.problem: The aqueous stream carries ethanol and ester.
records.candidate_operation: Recover organics by distillation where recovery requirements justify it.
records.physical_or_process_reason: Reduce material losses and return useful components; water reuse is specific to this case.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Recovered organics, water quality, duty and effect of recycle on the reactor.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Recovery economics or quality constraints favor another handling option.

records.problem: Recovered streams affect upstream composition and downstream loads.
records.candidate_operation: Connect compatible recovery streams and solve the resulting recycle.
records.physical_or_process_reason: The paper returns acid and recovered organics to reaction and part of the organic phase to the initial column.
records.chepta_calculation_required: Converged flowsheet balances, impurity accumulation and changed equipment loads.
records.conditions_to_reconsider: Incompatible composition, accumulation or excessive recycle burden.
